magic/ohen/odolnost-vuci-zaru.name: Heat Resistance
profile: Heat Resistance helps a willing creature withstand ordinary heat and strengthens its magical defense against specified fire hazards. It is useful both for expeditions into hot environments and for encounters with fire magic. Its manifestation in the story may be subtle: what matters is the specific protection actually provided by the rules.

When using it, distinguish ordinary heat, fire spells, and other kinds of attack. The bonus to magical defense does not cover every danger in the world. The caster must come within reach of a willing target and account for the duration of one scene. Protection can support a thoughtful approach, but it is no reason to ignore other threats in a dangerous environment.

Exact effect: The target ignores ordinary heat and gains +3 MDEF only against fire spells and magical heat. Bonus: +3 MDEF against fire. Target: 1 willing creature within reach. Duration: 1 scene. Restrictions: once per scene per target. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/ohen/plamenny-stit.name: Flame Shield
profile: Flame Shield briefly strengthens the physical defense of the caster or a visible ally against melee attacks. Its name may suggest dangerous flames, but under the rules it provides protection. It does not itself damage the attacker, an important distinction when deciding how the protected hero will act in a close confrontation.

It is best timed for two rounds in which pressure from melee combat is expected. Attacks from other directions or of other kinds are not automatically covered by the same benefit. The spell does not stack and has a limited number of uses per combat. Its benefit should therefore be assessed alongside the target's other defenses and the whole party's plan.

Exact effect: The target gains +2 PDEF only against melee attacks. The shield itself does not damage the attacker. Bonus: +2 PDEF. Target: caster or 1 ally within sight. Duration: 2 rounds. Restrictions: once per combat; does not stack. Using it requires at least Intelligence 8 and Level 2, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/ohen/ohnive-kopi.name: Flame Spear
profile: Flame Spear is an advanced attack focused on a single visible target. It can be a striking moment in combat, when the caster brings stronger fire magic to bear against a significant opponent. Although its appearance resembles a weapon, it is not an ordinary spear held in the hand or a tool for repeated physical thrusts.

Because it is available only once per combat, choosing the moment and the target matters. Damage is calculated using the standard magical formula against the opponent's defense and is not guaranteed in advance. The spell does not automatically hit further enemies behind the first target. Its higher requirements emphasize that it is not a replacement for a basic attack for every novice caster.

Exact effect: A powerful single-target attack; damage is calculated using the standard formula against MDEF. Bonus: +5 to MATK. Target: 1 target within sight. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per combat. Using it requires at least Intelligence 10 and Level 5, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/ohen/ohniva-koule.name: Fireball
profile: Fireball is an area fire attack for several targets standing close together. Its role differs from that of a powerful spell against one opponent: it hits more targets but uses a bonus adjusted for the area-attack rule. In a story, it can decide a tense moment, although the actual positions of those involved still matter.

Before casting, it is important to choose the targets and follow the shared area-attack rule. One roll is checked against each target's magical defense separately, so the results need not be identical. An unlimited crowd cannot be hit automatically. The limit of one use per combat encourages waiting for a genuinely suitable situation rather than expecting the same power against an individual and a group.

Exact effect: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. The bonus is already reduced relative to a comparable single-target spell. Bonus: +3 to MATK. Target: at most 3 targets close together. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per combat; the shared area-attack rule applies. Using it requires at least Intelligence 9 and Level 3, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/ohen/ohniva-zed.name: Wall of Fire
profile: Wall of Fire combines a hit when it appears with a short-lived obstacle in the area. It is useful for dividing the battlefield or interrupting a normal route when the party needs to buy time. Its danger to targets is precisely limited in time: its creation may hit them, but according to the catalog its continued existence does not add further damage.

When planning, distinguish the initial area attack from the subsequent obstruction of sight and passage. It does not inflict repeated damage every round. The short line has limits on both its length and the number of targets it hits, so good placement matters. The wall can help a retreat, but it can also cut the party off from a route it intended to use.

Exact effect: When created, it hits at most 3 targets in a line using the area-attack rule. The wall then blocks sight and normal passage, but deals no further damage. Bonus: +2 to MATK. Target: a line up to 5 m long; at most 3 targets when created. Duration: 3 rounds. Restrictions: once per combat. Using it requires at least Intelligence 10 and Level 5, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/ohen/draci-dech.name: Dragon's Breath
profile: Dragon's Breath is a striking advanced fire spell that hits several targets in a cone. Its name conveys its powerful appearance but does not give the caster all the abilities of a dragon. In a story, it is a rare moment that the hero chooses after weighing the situation and the rest of the expedition.

Its use is limited to once per adventure, so it should not be relied on in every encounter. The cone and at most three targets must be defined according to the area-attack rule. One roll is compared separately with each target's magical defense. The strength of the attack does not make it an unlimited weapon against an entire army or a guarantee of victory.

Exact effect: A very powerful area fire attack. One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. Bonus: +4 to MATK. Target: a cone; at most 3 targets. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per adventure; the area-attack rule applies. Using it requires at least Intelligence 11 and Level 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/vytvoreni-vody.name: Create Water
profile: Create Water supplies clean drinking water in a prepared container. It is useful to a traveler who must consider supplies as well as enemies. In a story, it can change the party's mood during a dry journey or help with everyday camp maintenance. A prepared container is part of using the spell, rather than a detail that can be skipped.

The spell provides a limited amount of water per scene, so it does not replace an unlimited supply for an entire city. The acquired water is best distributed according to the expedition's needs. It does not create a pressurized stream or ice and should not automatically be given an offensive function. Its strength lies in practical assistance and the ability to continue with reasonably replenished supplies.

Exact effect: Creates clean drinking water in a prepared container. Does not create a pressurized stream or ice. Target: an empty container within reach. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: at most 5 liters per scene. Using it requires at least Intelligence 6, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

Target, duration, restrictions, and exact effect.

magic/voda/vodni-proud.name: Water Jet
profile: Water Jet is a magical attack against a single visible target that can briefly change its position as well as deal damage. In a story, it suits a caster who works with movement and the space around an opponent. However, the additional push is not guaranteed on every cast: it requires actually dealing at least one Hit Point of damage.

The push affects an ordinary target and moves it only a short step, rather than any chosen distance. A large or main opponent is not moved. The limit on the same target per round must be respected when several casters work together. A hero can use the spell to make a small change to the situation, but should not infer that it automatically disables a powerful enemy.

Exact effect: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, it also pushes an ordinary target back a short step. A large or main opponent is not moved. Bonus: +1 to MATK. Target: 1 target within sight. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: at most 1 push per target per round. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/ledova-strela.name: Ice Bolt
profile: Ice Bolt is a direct attack of the Water and Ice school against a single visible target. Its appearance can emphasize piercing cold and precise aim, but the outcome follows the standard resolution of a magical attack. It does not freeze the surrounding area or create a lasting item that the party could use again later.

It suits a situation in which the caster needs a clearly aimed attack against a specific opponent. Damage depends on the opponent's magical defense and the attack result. The spell itself does not add slowing or a prohibition on movement simply because it uses ice. Such additional effects must be distinguished from those of other spells that explicitly list them.

Exact effect: A direct ice attack; damage is calculated against the target's MDEF. Bonus: +2 to MATK. Target: 1 target within sight. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: —. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/mrazivy-dotek.name: Freezing Touch
profile: Freezing Touch combines an attack from immediate proximity with a chance to weaken the target's next physical attack. In a story, it is a risky move that requires the caster to come within arm's reach. The spell's icy manifestation is striking, but the opponent does not automatically lose an entire turn or every ability to react to what is happening nearby.

The additional penalty arises only if at least one Hit Point of damage is dealt, and it applies to the next physical attack. It does not stack and has a limited duration. The decision therefore depends on whether such an attack is expected and whether the hero can approach safely. The spell does not replace the caster's defenses against possible retaliation.

Exact effect: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, the target also takes −1 to its next PATK. The penalty does not stack. Bonus: +2 to MATK. Target: 1 target within arm's reach. Duration: until the end of the target's next turn. Restrictions: —. Using it requires at least Intelligence 8, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/kraceni-po-vode.name: Walk on Water
profile: Walk on Water allows a willing creature to move across a calm surface of water as if it were solid ground. It is a spell for crossing terrain that can open a route to a small island, a shore, or another destination beyond the water. The caster does not remove every nearby obstacle or give the entire party the same benefit with a single use.

Before stepping onto the surface, consider the route and the ten-minute duration. Calm water is an important condition; a strong wave may require an Agility check. The spell does not deal with attacks, dangers beneath the surface, or an unreachable destination beyond the horizon. The return journey can make an interesting scene when the spell's duration must be coordinated with the expedition's plan.

Exact effect: The target can move across calm water as if it were solid ground. A strong wave may require an AGI check. Target: 1 willing creature within reach. Duration: 10 minutes. Restrictions: once per scene per target. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/dychani-pod-vodou.name: Water Breathing
profile: Water Breathing helps one willing creature during a brief underwater exploration. It can allow the creature to examine a flooded passage, search for an item, or approach a place that would otherwise be difficult to reach. It addresses the specific need to breathe, rather than every ability a character would need to move safely and quickly in an aquatic environment.

Before submerging, it makes sense to plan the length of the journey and the return. The spell does not add better vision, swimming speed, or resistance to pressure, so other conditions may remain dangerous. Its ten-minute duration is not an unlimited stay underwater. For the party, it offers a chance to cooperate in preparing, providing support, and helping the explorer return.

Exact effect: The target can breathe normally underwater. The spell grants no extra speed, vision, or resistance to pressure. Target: 1 willing creature within reach. Duration: 10 minutes. Restrictions: once per scene per target. Using it requires at least Intelligence 8, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/ledovy-stit.name: Ice Shield
profile: Ice Shield briefly provides magical support to the physical defense of the caster or a visible ally. Its appearance in the story may resemble a cold protective layer, but what matters is the exact defensive bonus. Its name alone does not add a freezing counterattack, slow an enemy, or provide special protection against every spell threatening the party.

It is useful when a physical attack is expected during the next two rounds. Choose the protected target and account for its other active defenses, because the effect does not stack. Limited use per combat encourages thoughtful timing. The party can take advantage of the brief protection during an important maneuver, but should not treat it as lasting safety.

Exact effect: The target gains +2 PDEF against physical attacks. Bonus: +2 PDEF. Target: caster or 1 ally within sight. Duration: 2 rounds. Restrictions: once per combat; does not stack. Using it requires at least Intelligence 8 and Level 2, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/zmrazeni.name: Freeze
profile: Freeze restricts the movement of one visible target. On success, it can freeze an ordinary opponent in place, creating a brief opportunity to change the distance or the course of the encounter. However, the target can still act within reach. The spell is therefore not the same as completely immobilizing the mind, removing all actions, or automatically disabling the target.

The distinction between an ordinary and a main opponent is essential: the main target receives a penalty to its next movement check instead of being frozen in place. The limited duration and one use per target per combat rule out continuously renewing the same blockage. The party should have a specific plan to exploit the brief change in movement and account for the target's remaining ways to react.

Exact effect: On success, an ordinary target is frozen in place and cannot move; it can still act within reach. A main opponent instead takes −2 to its next movement check. Bonus: +2 to MATK. Target: 1 target within sight. Duration: 1 round. Restrictions: once per target per combat; the main-opponent rule applies. Using it requires at least Intelligence 9 and Level 3, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/ledova-zed.name: Ice Wall
profile: Ice Wall creates a short-lived obstacle that blocks movement and sight. It is useful for separating part of an area or buying time when the party needs to change its approach. The rules define its durability in Hit Points and physical defense; it is not an indestructible boundary that every opponent must simply stop before.

The wall appears along an unobstructed line and has a limited length and duration. Placement requires considering the party's own route and an enemy's ability to damage the obstacle. When the effect ends, it melts without causing a dangerous flood. It cannot therefore be used as an automatic source of another area attack or have its dimensions changed without limit to suit the caster's wishes.

Exact effect: Creates an obstacle with 10 HP and PDEF 12 that blocks movement and sight. When the effect ends, it melts without causing a dangerous flood. Bonus: does not increase PDEF or MDEF; the wall has PDEF 12. Target: an unobstructed line up to 4 m long. Duration: 3 rounds. Restrictions: once per combat. Using it requires at least Intelligence 10 and Level 5, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/voda/ledova-boure.name: Ice Storm
profile: Ice Storm is a powerful area attack against several targets standing close together. In addition to the damage resolved by the rules, it can make their next movement check more difficult. In a story, it is a striking intervention in a moment of combat, but its rules scope still covers at most three targets rather than the entire battlefield.

Its use is limited to once per adventure, so the actual need matters. One attack is compared separately with each target's defense, and the results may differ. The additional movement penalty is not a complete halt or permanent freezing. The party needs suitably positioned targets and a plan for following up on the resulting situation.

Exact effect: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. A hit target also takes −1 to its next movement check. Bonus: +4 to MATK. Target: at most 3 targets close together. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per adventure; the area-attack rule applies. Using it requires at least Intelligence 11 and Level 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/vzduch/poryv-vetru.name: Gust of Wind
profile: Gust of Wind helps move a light item or attempts to briefly change a creature's position. It can support an inventive idea during exploration or combat. However, handling an item and attacking a creature have different conditions; the caster cannot treat every target as something equally easy to blow away.

When using it, account for weight, range, and the nature of the target. Against a creature, a magical attack is resolved, and a large or main opponent is not moved. An ordinary creature moves only a short step. The gust therefore offers a small change to the situation rather than unlimited movement of an entire group or the certain removal of the strongest enemy from the battlefield.

Exact effect: Blows an item up to 5 kg a few meters away. Against a creature, make a MATK attack against MDEF; an ordinary target moves a short step, but a large or main opponent does not. Bonus: +0 to MATK against a creature. Target: a light item or 1 target within 10 m. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: 1 attempt per target per round. Using it requires at least Intelligence 6, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/vzduch/tlumeny-pad.name: Feather Fall
profile: Feather Fall is a reaction to the specific danger of a falling creature. It can provide an important moment of rescue while climbing, exploring heights, or facing the unexpected collapse of a floor. Its protection is precisely limited by the height of the fall. It is not a general shield that protects the hero from every further threat during the descent or after landing.

The caster must see the falling creature and have one of the limited uses per scene available. The spell negates damage from a fall up to the specified height, rather than from any drop. It does not stop a falling item or another attack. On a planned expedition into high places, it therefore supplements securing lines and caution but does not erase every possible consequence of a poor decision.

magic/vzduch/bleskova-strela.name: Lightning Bolt
profile: Lightning Bolt is a direct magical attack against a single visible target. Its brief electrical manifestation can express the caster's sudden decision to strike a specific opponent. Under the rules, it is a clearly aimed spell: its name does not mean an automatic hit on other nearby creatures or an unlimited change to the weather above the battlefield.

The attack is resolved against the target's magical defense, so casting alone does not determine the amount of damage. It does not add unlisted stunning, loss of a turn, or chaining between neighboring opponents. For the party, it can provide a well-defined basic attack option from this school, while stronger and area spells require different choices of situation and available uses.

Exact effect: A direct lightning attack against the target's MDEF. Bonus: +2 to MATK. Target: 1 target within sight. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: —. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/vzduch/vetrny-stit.name: Wind Shield
profile: Wind Shield provides brief protection against ranged physical attacks. It is useful when opponents rely on projectiles and the party needs to move or protect a specific member. Its focus is narrow: the defensive effect cannot automatically be extended to melee combat, spells, or every danger coming from farther away.

The caster can choose themselves or a visible ally and must account for the short duration. One use per combat and the prohibition on stacking encourage thoughtful timing. Before casting, it is important to determine what the enemy is actually attacking with. A well-chosen shield can help cross an exposed stretch, but does not replace a plan against other kinds of attack.

Exact effect: The target gains +2 PDEF against ranged physical attacks. Provides no protection against melee combat or spells. Bonus: +2 PDEF. Target: caster or 1 ally within sight. Duration: 2 rounds. Restrictions: once per combat; only against projectiles; does not stack. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/vzduch/levitace.name: Levitation
profile: Levitation raises a chosen target to a low height and allows slow vertical movement. It can help with handling a load or a brief movement above the ground, but it is not the same as unrestricted flight. It also distinguishes an item, a willing creature, and an opponent that resists; the caster cannot automatically lift everything they point at.

Limits apply to weight, distance, height, and concentration. Against an unwilling creature, resolution against magical defense is required. A main opponent is not lifted and instead receives only the listed movement restriction. The spell does not take away its action. magic/vzduch/blesk.name: Thunderbolt
profile: Thunderbolt is a stronger attack against a single visible target. In a story, it can be a decisive moment that shows the caster's ability to wield the power of the Air school. Its attack bonus is higher than that of the basic bolt, but the resulting damage still follows the standard magical resolution against the particular opponent's defense.

Because it can be used only once per combat, it makes sense to choose an important target and a suitable moment. The spell is not an automatic attack on an entire group or a source of a lasting electrical field. It does not add unlisted paralysis. The party can build its strategy around one powerful strike but still needs a plan in case the result is weaker.

Exact effect: A powerful single-target lightning attack against the target's MDEF. Bonus: +4 to MATK. Target: 1 target within sight. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per combat. Using it requires at least Intelligence 9 and Level 2, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/vzduch/teleportace-predmetu.name: Teleport Object
profile: Teleport Object transfers a restricted nonmagical item between visible locations. It can help retrieve something otherwise inaccessible or place it at a suitable point. It does not allow treasure to be freely obtained from an unknown room: the caster must see both the origin and the destination and respect the weight and distance limits.

Using it on an unattached item differs from using it on something held by another person. The holder resists with magical defense, and a main opponent's item cannot be taken this way. The destination must be an empty location. The spell therefore supports a thoughtful idea rather than automatically disarming every enemy or transferring anything without limits.

Exact effect: Transfers an unattached item to an empty location. A held item requires MATK against the holder's MDEF; a main opponent's item cannot be taken. Bonus: +0 to MATK for a held item. Target: a nonmagical item up to 5 kg. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per scene; both origin and destination must be within sight and 20 m. Using it requires at least Intelligence 9 and Level 3, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

magic/vzduch/let.name: Flight
profile: Flight allows the caster or one willing creature to move through the air. It can change an exploration route, help overcome an obstacle, or offer a different view of the landscape. However, it does not permanently grant wings. The duration depends on whether the spell is used in combat or outside it and must be monitored.

A plan for returning to the ground matters. When the effect ends, the spell provides a safe descent only from a low height; from higher up, the catalog requires Feather Fall. Its speed is approximately running speed, rather than unlimited travel around the world. The ability to fly therefore offers a real advantage while also requiring good timing and responsible decisions.

Exact effect: The target flies at approximately running speed. When the effect ends, it safely descends at most 3 m; from a greater height it needs Feather Fall. Target: caster or 1 willing creature within reach. Duration: 3 rounds in combat or 10 minutes outside combat. Restrictions: once per scene. magic/vzduch/retezovy-blesk.name: Chain Lightning
profile: Chain Lightning hits a limited group of targets linked by their proximity to one another. Its appearance in the story can be swift and impressive, but under the rules it is an area attack with at most three targets. The opponents' positions are part of using it: arbitrary people scattered across the entire area cannot be chosen regardless of their distances.

One roll is compared separately with each chosen target's magical defense. The results therefore need not be identical, and the attack does not continue onward without limit. It is available once per combat. It makes sense to watch the enemies' positions and decide whether this strike against a group is more useful than another attack focused on a single opponent.

Exact effect: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. Bonus: +3 to MATK. Target: at most 3 targets, each within a few meters of the previous one. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per combat; the area-attack rule applies. Using it requires at least Intelligence 10 and Level 5, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. magic/vzduch/teleportace-osoby.name: Teleport Person
profile: Teleport Person instantly moves the caster or one willing creature to a visible, safe location within nearby range. It can help with escape, crossing an obstacle, or changing position in combat. Its value comes from a rapid change of location, rather than the ability to travel anywhere in the world without knowing the destination.

The destination must be empty, safe, visible, and within the stated distance. The spell cannot enter an unknown room or travel between worlds. Moving a willing creature requires being within reach, and the spell is limited to one use per combat. Choosing whom to move right now can be interesting when the entire party may not share the same escape route.

Exact effect: Transfers the target to a visible, safe location. Cannot enter an unknown space or travel between worlds. Target: caster or 1 willing creature within reach. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: once per combat; the empty destination must be within sight and 30 m. Using it requires at least Intelligence 11 and Level 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

strings.Ukáže směr k nejbližšímu dosažitelnému z: Shows the direction of the nearest reachable water source within 1 km. Does not determine whether the water is safe to drink.
strings.1 ruka; bez útoku a složité jemné práce: 1 hand; no attacks or complex fine work
strings.Vytvoří viditelnou magickou ruku, která: Creates a visible magical hand that can lift, carry, or set down an item, or press a simple mechanism. This is not Telekinesis and cannot affect a creature.
strings.volný předmět do 2 kg a 5 m: an unattached item up to 2 kg within 5 m
strings.1 nemagický předmět do velikosti batohu: 1 nonmagical item no larger than a backpack
strings.1× na stejné poškození; musí být přítomn: once per instance of damage; all parts must be present
strings.Spojí prasklinu, přetržený řemínek nebo: Mends a crack, a broken strap, or a small broken component. Does not restore consumed contents or magic.
strings.1 předmět, tvor nebo prostor do 5 m: 1 item, creature, or area within 5 m
strings.Odhalí přítomnost magie a její nejbližší: Detects the presence of magic and its closest school. Does not reveal its exact effect, trigger, or how to dispel it.
strings.Provede zkoušku CH proti 7/9/11 podle kv: Makes an INT check against 7/9/11 depending on the lock's quality. Success opens the lock; it does not dispel a magical lock or disarm a trap.
strings.2× za souboj; nesčítá se s jiným magický: twice per combat; does not stack with another magical bonus to the same defense
strings.Cíl získá +1 k FO i MO proti jednomu pří: The target gains +1 to both PDEF and MDEF against the next attack.
strings.do příštího útoku proti cíli, nejdéle 1: until the next attack against the target, at most 1 round
strings.Proveď magický útok. Zranění se vypočte: Make a magical attack. Damage is calculated using the standard formula against the target's MDEF.
strings.Přímý jednobodový magický útok ohněm pro: A direct, single-target magical fire attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.Silnější útok vyvážený nutností dotyku;: A stronger attack balanced by requiring touch; damage is determined against MDEF.
strings.sesilatel musí stát těsně u cíle: the caster must stand immediately beside the target
strings.Útoky vedené skrz clonu mají −2 k výsled: Attacks made through the screen take −2 to their final PATK or MATK. The penalty applies to both sides.
strings.Cíl ignoruje běžné horko a získá +3 MO p: The target ignores ordinary heat and gains +3 MDEF only against fire spells and magical heat.
strings.1× za souboj; nesčítá se: once per combat; does not stack
strings.Cíl získá +2 FO pouze proti útokům zblíz: The target gains +2 PDEF only against melee attacks. The shield itself does not damage the attacker.
strings.Silný jednobodový útok; zranění se vypoč: A powerful single-target attack; damage is calculated using the standard formula against MDEF.
strings.1× za souboj; platí společné plošné prav: once per combat; the shared area-attack rule applies
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná zvlášť s MO každ: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. The bonus is already reduced relative to a comparable single-target spell.
strings.Při vzniku zasáhne nejvýše 3 cíle v lini: When created, it hits at most 3 targets in a line using the area-attack rule. The wall then blocks sight and normal passage, but deals no further damage.
strings.linie do 5 m; nejvýše 3 cíle při vzniku: a line up to 5 m long; at most 3 targets when created
strings.1× za dobrodružství; platí plošné pravid: once per adventure; the area-attack rule applies
strings.Velmi silný plošný ohnivý útok. Jeden ho: A very powerful area fire attack. One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF.
strings.Vytvoří čistou pitnou vodu v připravené: Creates clean drinking water in a prepared container. Does not create a pressurized stream or ice.
strings.Při zranění alespoň 1 Ž navíc odstrčí bě: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, it also pushes an ordinary target back a short step. A large or main opponent is not moved.
strings.posunutí nejvýše 1× na stejný cíl za kol: at most 1 push per target per round
strings.Přímý ledový útok; zranění se vypočte pr: A direct ice attack; damage is calculated against the target's MDEF.
strings.Při zranění alespoň 1 Ž má cíl navíc −1: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, the target also takes −1 to its next PATK. The penalty does not stack.
strings.do konce příštího tahu cíle: until the end of the target's next turn
strings.Cíl se může pohybovat po klidné vodní hl: The target can move across calm water as if it were solid ground. A strong wave may require an AGI check.
strings.Cíl může normálně dýchat pod vodou. Kouz: The target can breathe normally underwater. The spell grants no extra speed, vision, or resistance to pressure.
The target gains +2 PDEF against physical attacks.
strings.1× na stejný cíl za souboj; platí pravid: once per target per combat; the main-opponent rule applies
strings.Při úspěchu je běžný cíl přimražen k mís: On success, an ordinary target is frozen in place and cannot move; it can still act within reach. A main opponent instead takes −2 to its next movement check.
strings.Vytvoří překážku s 10 Ž a FO 12, která b: Creates an obstacle with 10 HP and PDEF 12 that blocks movement and sight. When the effect ends, it melts without causing a dangerous flood.
strings.nezvyšuje FO ani MO; zeď má FO 12: does not increase PDEF or MDEF; the wall has PDEF 12
strings.volná linie do 4 m: an unobstructed line up to 4 m long
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná zvlášť s MO každ: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. A hit target also takes −1 to its next movement check.
strings.Předmět do 5 kg odfoukne o několik metrů: Blows an item up to 5 kg a few meters away. Against a creature, make a MATK attack against MDEF; an ordinary target moves a short step, but a large or main opponent does not.
strings.lehký předmět nebo 1 cíl do 10 m: a light item or 1 target within 10 m
strings.Zruší zranění z pádu do 10 m a dovolí be: Negates damage from a fall of up to 10 m and allows a safe landing. Does not stop another attack or a falling item.
strings.nezvyšuje FO ani MO: does not increase PDEF or MDEF
A direct lightning attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.1× za souboj; pouze proti střelám; nesčí: once per combat; only against projectiles; does not stack
strings.Cíl získá +2 FO proti fyzickým útokům na: The target gains +2 PDEF against ranged physical attacks. Provides no protection against melee combat or spells.
strings.+0 k MÚ proti neochotnému cíli: +0 to MATK against an unwilling target
strings.1 tvor nebo předmět do 100 kg a 10 m: 1 creature or item up to 100 kg within 10 m
strings.1× za scénu; hlavní protivník neztratí a: once per scene; a main opponent does not lose its action
strings.Cíl se zvedne nejvýše 3 m a může se poma: The target rises at most 3 m and can move slowly vertically. An unwilling creature resists with MDEF. A main opponent is not lifted and instead has half movement until the end of its next turn.
strings.Silný jednobodový bleskový útok proti MO: A powerful single-target lightning attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.+0 k MÚ u drženého předmětu: +0 to MATK for a held item
strings.1× za scénu; výchozí i cílové místo musí: once per scene; both origin and destination must be within sight and 20 m
Transfers an unattached item to an empty location. A held item requires MATK against the holder's MDEF; a main opponent's item cannot be taken.
strings.nemagický předmět do 5 kg: a nonmagical item up to 5 kg
strings.3 kola v souboji nebo 10 minut mimo něj: 3 rounds in combat or 10 minutes outside combat
strings.Cíl létá přibližně rychlostí běhu. Po sk: The target flies at approximately running speed. When the effect ends, it safely descends at most 3 m; from a greater height it needs Feather Fall.
strings.sesilatel nebo 1 ochotný tvor na dosah: caster or 1 willing creature within reach
strings.1× za souboj; platí plošné pravidlo: once per combat; the area-attack rule applies
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná zvlášť s MO každ: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF.
strings.nejvýše 3 cíle, každý do několika metrů: at most 3 targets, each within a few meters of the previous one
strings.1× za souboj; cílové prázdné místo musí: once per combat; the empty destination must be within sight and 30 m
Transfers the target to a visible, safe location. Cannot enter an unknown space or travel between worlds.
